answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 43990 Country: India Title: Salah time Question: Alhamdulillah, I am following Hanafi Madhhab. We have shop where we used to go at 4 o’clock which makes our Asr salah Qaza. I just want to know so is that possible we offer Asr salah at Shafi time as their time starts early. I heard from our local Imam that often we can offer but we should not have to make habit of praying early. Also can we offer it with Jamah? Answer ID: 43990 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 281/297/N=1434) Just like Shafai maslak, the Imam Abu Yusuf, Imam Muhammad, , Imam Malik, Imam Ahmad ibn Hambal and as per one saying of Imam Abu Hanifa (رحمهم الله), Asr time starts after mithl awwal. But the famous saying of Imam Abu Hanifa (رحمة الله عليه) is that the time of Asr starts after mithl sani and It is preferred saying as per all the Hanafi Fiqh books and it is stronger as per the proofs. Also in case of offering Asr salah after mithl awwal and before mithl sani, it is doubtful whether the fardh was fulfilled. Hence you should offer Asr salah after mithl sani and should not offer before it. When you reach your shop at 4 o’clock then you should close your shop or adopt any other method and go to mosque for Asr salah when Asr time starts. Do not miss your salah due to shop as well as do not offer it before time (mithl sani). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
